component.name: Archium
component.summary: Arc and Zen style browser with Helium's privacy defaults

description.p: Archium is a web browser with Arc's sidebar and Zen's colours, built on Electron, with privacy defaults in the style of Helium.

ul.li: Spaces with colour gradients, favourites, pinned tabs and Today tabs that archive themselves
A command bar, Glance, split view, compact mode, Boosts and Little Archium
Ghostery blocking, URL cleaning, HTTPS first, no third-party cookies and DNS over HTTPS
Four looks: Arc, Zen, Liquid Glass and Retro 98

screenshot.caption: The sidebar with spaces, pinned tabs and Today tabs
